feeding_claim.verbatim: Some of these animals will be introduced to a grain diet with free choice hay.

notes: Verified 2026-11-22 against the about, products and contact pages. Quote confirmed; some calves go onto grain with free-choice hay and the others stay on a grass-fed diet, and the store lists grass-fed, grain finished beef, so category both. Hogs are bought as 50 lb feeder pigs from local farms and finished on the farm on grain plus forage; chickens on pasture with some grain. Delivery to Champaign, Effingham and Mattoon/Charleston; farm store Saturday 9 to 12:30 or by appointment. Barn2Door shop could not be fetched, so pickup locations are not listed.
